skill.name: universal-audit
skill.description: Formal, evidence-based software engineering audit producing a scored, gated release verdict. Use when asked for a "full audit", "production audit", "release audit", "formal audit", "audit report with a verdict", "is this safe to ship", customer-assurance review, or a re-audit against a prior report. Runs the Universal Software Engineering Audit Specification v2.2 end to end: intake, control selection, evidence ledger, deterministic scoring, release gates, machine-readable artifacts. NOT for quick cleanup passes or refactoring - use a lighter review flow for those.
skill.summary: Run a structured software engineering audit with evidence tracking, control coverage, scoring, challenge review, and a release verdict.
skill.author: glenskii

content.value_statement: Release decisions often fail when evidence, scope, and control coverage are incomplete. This skill organizes an authorized audit, scores the evidence, challenges findings, and produces a traceable verdict.
actual_capabilities: Defines audit scope, depth, environment, access level, and assurance objectives.
Selects controls from the bundled specification and records coverage denominators.
Organizes evidence observations, limitations, findings, and verification outcomes.
Runs the bundled scoring script to calculate category scores and release gates.
Produces structured audit artifacts and a plain-language release recommendation.
limitations: It cannot prove runtime behavior when the repository, environment, or evidence is unavailable.
Active testing requires documented authorization and suitable test systems.
The scoring script does not replace expert judgment for qualitative release gates.
It does not remediate application defects or manage production deployments.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Release Audit
use_cases.description: Define scope, select controls, gather evidence, and prepare a release decision for a production change.

use_cases.title: Review Security Readiness
use_cases.description: Trace security claims to implementation evidence and identify unresolved risks before customer release.

use_cases.title: Challenge an Audit Report
use_cases.description: Re-audit prior findings, run an independent contradiction pass, and document changed evidence and status.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Rapid Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this repository at the rapid tier. First state the scope, assumptions, limitations, and evidence you need. Do not run active tests without authorization.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Release Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this release against the Universal Software Engineering Audit Specification. Select applicable controls, record evidence gaps, and recommend a release verdict with reasons.

prompt_templates.title: Build the Evidence Ledger
prompt_templates.prompt: For this authorized audit, organize observations by control. Include source locations, methods, sanitized excerpts, limitations, and the status required by the specification.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Re-Audit Challenge
prompt_templates.prompt: Re-audit the supplied prior report. Reproduce each unresolved finding where authorized, classify its current status, recalculate coverage and scoring, and document an independent challenge of release-significant findings.

output_examples.input: Audit a web application before production release at the standard tier.
output_examples.output: Scope and assumptions; selected controls; evidence ledger; findings with severity and confidence; coverage percentages; score sheet; independent challenge log; final release recommendation.

output_examples.input: Re-audit the previous report after the authentication changes.
output: Prior findings classified as open, partially remediated, remediated, accepted, regressed, or not reproducible.
Recalculated release gates and a traceable recommendation.

best_practices: Provide the exact commit, build, environment, and authorization boundaries before evidence collection.
Treat missing evidence as unverified and record the limitation instead of inferring a pass.
Keep evidence sanitized, traceable, and separate from the final qualitative judgment.
anti_patterns: Do not call a limited review full production assurance.
Do not use a high numeric score to override an unresolved release gate.
Do not perform active or destructive tests without explicit authorization.

faq.question: What does this skill audit?
faq.answer: It audits software engineering controls across governance, security, architecture, code, supply chain, infrastructure, data, reliability, and release operations.

faq.question: Can it audit a live application?
faq.answer: It can assess an authorized live target, but active testing requires documented rules of engagement and appropriate access.

faq.question: What happens when evidence is missing?
faq.answer: The result records the control as unverified and explains what evidence would be required for a pass.

faq.question: Does it fix discovered problems?
faq.answer: No. It documents findings and recommendations, but remediation remains with the engineering team.

faq.question: How are release scores calculated?
faq.answer: The bundled scoring script calculates category scores, coverage, mandatory caps, and release gates from the selected controls.

faq.question: Can it re-audit an earlier report?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the prior report and current evidence so each prior finding can be classified and the release decision recalculated.
